description: Side-by-side comparison of 2–5 schools with ordinal competition ranks within the selected set (ties share a rank). Topics: costs (tuition, net price by income bracket, debt), admissions (acceptance rate, SAT/ACT, enrollment), outcomes (completion, earnings, repayment), aid (Pell grants, federal loans, debt, repayment). Use scorecard_get_school for full profiles.

ids.description: Array of 2–5 school unit IDs to compare.

anyOf.description: Base-10 school ID resolving to a positive safe integer; whitespace, leading zeros, plus, decimal, and exponent forms are accepted.

topic.description: Comparison topic: costs, admissions, outcomes, or aid.

name: scorecard_compare_schools

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `api_conflict`: The provider reported a request conflict. `api_invalid_params`: Provider rejected a query parameter. `api_validation`: A meaningful selector or provider value is invalid. `api_unauthorized`: The provider rejected the API credentials. `api_forbidden`: The provider denied access. `api_rate_limited`: The provider throttled the request. `api_timeout`: The provider exchange exceeded its deadline. `api_not_found`: The provider endpoint returned HTTP 404. `api_invalid_request`: The provider returned an unexpected redirect. `api_internal`: The provider returned an unclassified HTTP response. `schools_not_found`: None of the requested school IDs returned records. `api_error`: The College Scorecard API returned an error. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Warning if some requested IDs returned no record.

rows.description: Comparison rows — one per metric, with per-school values and ranks.

items.description: Per-school data point for this metric.

availability.description: Available number, unavailable with unknown cause, or confirmed privacy suppression.

suppressed.description: True only for explicit provider privacy markers.

value.description: Raw metric value. Omitted when not available.

schools.description: Schools in the comparison set, in the same order as the ids input.

summary.description: Brief interpretive summary highlighting the most notable relative differences.

title: Compare Schools
